title: problem_modeling.clarification_question (v1)
description: ProblemModelingAgent asks the human a single clarification question during the ClarifyingResearchGoal dialogue (state machine V1.10 §1). May offer a fixed set of options and/or accept free text. The human's reply is emitted as human.clarification_answer, correlated by question_id.

question_id.description: Opaque identifier correlating this question with the human's human.clarification_answer reply.

question_text.description: The question presented to the human.

options.description: Optional fixed set of choices offered to the human alongside (or instead of) free text.

allow_free_text.description: Whether the human may answer with free text in addition to, or instead of, the offered options.
